projects.title: Jarvas
projects.summary: Privacy-first Hermes Agent assistant on a self-hosted ThinkCentre behind Tailscale, turning sources and workflows into project memory.

projects.title: Jarvas Mnemoteca
projects.summary: A living LLM wiki where sources, notes, decisions, and WIP gravity wells preserve continuity: https://gist.github.com/peterdays/54a8fd9f8a01355ec27a43ac3c49650a

projects.title: YouTube transcript ingestion
projects.summary: A curated playlist feeds transcripts into Jarvas so useful talks can become durable Mnemoteca context.

projects.title: Jarvas inbox ranking
projects.summary: Jarvas ranks read-it-later links by relevance and novelty before Pedro spends attention.

projects.title: OraXle
projects.summary: X-native oracle with its own LLM wiki for capturing and querying selected tweets, threads, X Articles, and native media; durable signals relay into Jarvas.

projects.title: LOOM
projects.summary: Personal project map: living timeline where projects grow like mycelium/neural/universe, linking agents, features, experiments, shipped work; no private notes.

projects.title: Grok Bot Galaxy livestream archive
projects.summary: Built during Grok Bot Galaxy: archive of xAI's 25-hour, 3-day livestream to search and replay: https://github.com/peterdays/grok-bot-galaxy-livestream-archive

projects.title: Transcription pipeline
projects.summary: Resumable yt-dlp download and checkpointed Faster-Whisper small.en transcription in 30-minute chunks, rendered to Markdown, TXT, SRT, VTT and JSONL.

projects.title: Scored chapters and viewing guides
projects.summary: 50 scored chapter notes with takeaways and caveats; rankings favor live coding, debugging and verification, and separate observed behavior from claims.

projects.title: Seekable local viewer
projects.summary: Dependency-free static viewer behind make run; timestamp links jump into local video through a byte-range server, without downloading the whole file first.

projects.title: Continuous format map
projects.summary: Viewer opens on a per-day map with thumbnails and tags for presentations, screen work, team discussion and breaks, each linked to its transcript slice.
